notes.title: MEGA PATCH III
notes.content:
MEGA-PATCH SEP 1ST 2025

Patch Notes:

~ added new options
~ new settings for streamers
~ game settings panel updates
~ added visible key-input to settings so people wont be accused of cheating during TAS runs


~ balanced celsuks attacks and added new ones
~ "secret" main menu boss fight is more optimized
~ sector 03 is prettier now
~ new outfits
~ added new event stage! burst challenge is now available and will rock your windows around like crazy
~ additional tracks added to the music room
~ various player control tweaks
~ extra stage dialog has been added
~ extra stage is a bit more balanced sort of
~ window movements can now occur no matter the window size (except for tarsus as he has window scaling effects in his fight)
~ fixed a major glitch where score entries wouldn't be saved at all
~ changed the music a 3rd time in the EXTRA SECTOR victory screen
~ new game over menu shaders
~ lots of more under the hood stuff

To-Do:

~ change event stage icons because the placeholders are still too ugly for me
~ add dialog to end of burst challenge event stage
~ add new shot types to clothes and additional weapons to be equipped from the gift shop
~ fix various bugs and inconsistencies
~ finish the rabbit hole of a prerelease webpage
~ add new NPCs and remove the placeholder ones from the Yvinaq Shore
~ new optimal shader fx
~ even MORE fps optimizations
~ unlockable music room entries for unused songs (eg. beat the game a certain way and unlock new secrets)
~ add a heart rate monitor effect to the GAME OVER screen
~ work on potential SACRED CHASM collab event
~ redesign the burst challenge icon

notes.title: APRIL MEGA PATCH
notes.content:
Hello! Here is the April Mega-patch...

This patch fixes many issues, as well as improves upon many attack patterns and background effects.

It also optimizes some bits of the game, especially during Stage 2 and the Extra Stage.

Aside from that, I added a death counter to the Sacred Finale attack so that it's easier to play, but still offers a challenging final segment.

The event stage has been edited a bit as well.

Also, the Trans flag has been added as an outfit!

Please let me know if the game breaks or feels off in certain places, thank you!

Also, I made a new discord for the game, as the previous one got hacked and deleted along with my old account..... (Please don't run fake versions of the game. Only use the Steam builds!)

https://discord.gg/n9WtbDs4Zv

notes.title: slight beautification patch + revival of secret boss
notes.content:
If you didn't know already, there's a hidden boss deep within the game... I won't give any hints, but you literally need to break the game in order to get to him! [i](I want hackers to find something fun...)[/i]
... Anyways! I created this super advanced attack shield thing with a bunch of weird math for him that is entirely objectID based! I wanted Tarsus's fight to last out longer without giving him extra HP, so it gives you JUST enough HP to defeat him with to reach his true final attack at the last second. Let me know what you all think of this!!

Also, I changed Taro's sprite a bit on the home screen so he pops out more, he almost looks like a little sticker now! :]

notes.title: New Mega-Patch, New Pride Outfit collection!
notes.content:
!!! It's been a minute...

I've been really busy working on promotional stuff for the game, I'm even hosting a URLFEST in the game too... Thank you all who playtest my work! The game is coming very close to being finished...

Also, I added a ton of new weapons and items for pride. Maybe in the future these items will actually do something with the C key, but I really don't wanna overcomplicate things!! If you're reading this, would you be interested in some additional mini-specials for weapons??

Please consider supporting it on Patreon too, as I've been making this project entirely for free...
https://patreon.com/nikuwolf
